pit_risk_notes: Option open interest is usually known with exchange/vendor lag; usable_trade_date must be after publication availability, not the same as quote date by default.
End-of-day bid/ask, IV, delta, and OI must carry vendor timestamp/as-of metadata to prevent lookahead.
Illiquid options can fabricate skew/OI signals; no overlay should tag names before option_liquidity_score is computed.
Short-squeeze interpretation needs structured short-interest or borrow-pressure data; headlines alone are biased and insufficient.
Earnings IV features require option dates aligned to earnings snapshot usable_trade_date.
